indicators: S3 bucket policy allowing Principal '*' with s3:GetObject action
Anonymous GetObject API calls observed in CloudTrail logs
S3 access logs showing GET requests from unknown external IPs
AWS Config non-compliance alert for public read access
IAM policies with overly broad permissions: 'Action': 's3:*', 'Resource': '*'
examples.detection_method: Deploy automated CSPM tools to scan bucket policies for public access flags; monitor CloudTrail for anonymous or unusual S3 GetObject calls; ingest S3 access logs to identify external IPs accessing sensitive objects; enforce AWS Config rules such as 's3-bucket-public-read-prohibited'; audit IAM policies to ensure least privilege; integrate alerts with SIEM for real-time notification.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
T1078 - Valid Accounts (due to use of anonymous access)
T1218 - Signed Binary Proxy Execution (if attacker uses AWS CLI or SDK tools)
